note: Cooling towers: the web page says 'Optimize all automated water-using equipment, like cooling towers'. The PDF guides do not name cooling towers. They say 'Review and adjust cooling, refrigeration and temperature-control systems to reduce water use where possible' (Stages 2–4; Stage 1 is similar).
